svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Elevation of a late Gothic Spanish entrance front: a portal under a pointed arch, tiers of canopied niches with statues, buttress-pinnacles at the sides and cresting along the top, and a great quartered coat of arms held on the breast of a spread eagle, with a round close-up of the eagle and shield. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
svg.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard
geometric construction of this form; no external drawing
